entries.symptom: npm install fails with ETARGET (No matching version found) for a version that exists
entries.cause: min-release-age=7 in .npmrc refuses versions younger than 7 days
entries.fix: Wait until the version is 7 days old, or pin the previous one; an exception goes only into a dated min-release-age-exclude block that expires (the dependency check enforces the date); never set min-release-age=0

entries.symptom: A package younger than 7 days installs although .npmrc sets min-release-age=7
entries.cause: npm keeps the last value, so a later min-release-age=0 switches the policy off; a malformed exclude line is honoured too
entries.fix: One min-release-age line; exceptions only as min-release-age-exclude[]=<pkg>@<version> in the dated block; the dependency check in npm run verify catches both loopholes

entries.symptom: npx expo install writes ~57.0.x (or a caret range for a third-party package) despite save-exact=true
entries.cause: expo install writes the SDK range for Expo-managed packages and a caret for packages outside its map
entries.fix: Keep Expo's ~ ranges for SDK packages; change caret pins of packages outside Expo's module map (ads, IAP, audio libraries) to exact versions

entries.symptom: verify turns red with no change in the repo: expo install --check prints "expected version: ~57.0.x" or expo-doctor fails "Patch version mismatches"
entries.cause: Expo published a patch less than 7 days ago; the fix the tools print (install it) is refused by the release-age rule
entries.fix: The dependency check reads the publish time (npm view <pkg> time) and prints a warning with the due date instead of failing; on that date run npx expo install <pkg>@~<version> and update the versions table in the same commit; never add an exclude block for it

entries.symptom: The dependency check fails right after npx expo install: the installed SDK package is one patch above the versions table
entries.cause: A bare npx expo install takes a same-day patch from Expo's online versions list
entries.fix: Install with the table spec (npx expo install <pkg>@<table spec>); the newer patch stays a warning until it is 7 days old

entries.symptom: ESLint crashes: ConfigError: ... Key "plugins": Cannot redefine plugin "@typescript-eslint"
entries.cause: Two copies of @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin: eslint-config-expo's caret range resolved a newer release while typescript-eslint nested its own
entries.fix: Pin every @typescript-eslint/* package to the typescript-eslint version with root overrides, npm install, and check npm ls @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin shows one version

entries.symptom: npx expo-doctor prints "Found duplicates for <native module>" (react-native-screens, react-native-safe-area-context ...)
entries.cause: Two versions of one native module in node_modules: a peer or a workspace pulled the newest release next to the one the app installs
entries.fix: Add a root override at the version the app installs (npx expo install chooses it), npm install, then npm ls <pkg> shows one copy

entries.symptom: npm latest react or react-native differs from the SDK pins
entries.cause: Only the Expo SDK decides the React and React Native versions
entries.fix: Never install either by hand; npx expo install --fix

entries.symptom: ESLint 10: contextOrFilename.getFilename is not a function (eslint-plugin-react)
entries.cause: eslint-config-expo 57 pulls eslint-plugin-react and eslint-plugin-import releases whose peers stop at ESLint 9
entries.fix: Pin eslint 9.39.5; move only when eslint-config-expo ships ESLint-10-ready plugins

entries.symptom: TypeScript 7 installed: typescript-eslint and other tools break
entries.cause: TypeScript 7 ships no compiler API yet; typescript-eslint 8 peers typescript below 6.1; Expo pins ~6.0
entries.fix: Stay on TypeScript ~6.0.3 until typescript-eslint supports 7 and Expo lists it

entries.symptom: Jest 30 breaks the jest-expo preset
entries.cause: jest-expo 57 depends on Jest 29 packages; SDK 57 pins jest ~29.7
entries.fix: Stay on Jest 29.7 until the jest-expo of the SDK depends on Jest 30

entries.symptom: Component tests fail oddly after installing @testing-library/react-native alone (npm ls shows test-renderer 1.3)
entries.cause: npm's automatic peer install picks test-renderer 1.3, which targets React 19.3 (SDK 58); SDK 57 is React 19.2, whose companion is test-renderer 1.2.0
entries.fix: Install both in one command: npm install --save-dev --save-exact @testing-library/react-native@14.0.1 test-renderer@1.2.0; npm ls test-renderer shows 1.2.0

entries.symptom: npm offers a newer react-native-gesture-handler 2.x (legacy tag) or 3.x
entries.cause: It is outside Expo SDK 57's ~2.32 range; Gesture Handler 3 renames the callbacks
entries.fix: Stay on what npx expo install picks; move with the SDK upgrade

entries.symptom: eslint-plugin-react-native blocks an ESLint upgrade
entries.cause: It has had no release for a long time and caps its peer range at ESLint 9
entries.fix: Drop the plugin when it blocks an upgrade; its rules are nice to have

entries.symptom: npm approve-scripts --allow-scripts-pending exits 0 even with unreviewed install scripts
entries.cause: The command reports but never fails
entries.fix: Fail unless its output says "No packages with unreviewed install scripts." (the dependency check does)

entries.symptom: npm flags lefthook's postinstall as an unreviewed install script, or lefthook writes lefthook.yml into an enclosing repo from a nested app
entries.cause: lefthook installs its hooks in postinstall, and from a nested folder it finds the outer repo's .git
entries.fix: Install hooks with the guarded prepare script (node scripts/hooks/install-git-hooks.ts) that installs only at the repo root; keep lefthook in allowScripts (npm 11.17 omits .bin/lefthook when its script is denied)

entries.symptom: The Skia install needs an approved install script
entries.cause: @shopify/react-native-skia downloads prebuilt binaries in an install step on SDK 57
entries.fix: Read the script, approve it in allowScripts, and drop the approval when an upgrade no longer has it

entries.symptom: fsevents appears as a pending install script after an install
entries.cause: An optional macOS file-watcher dependency of Jest ships a node-gyp rebuild script (npm explain fsevents shows the path)
entries.fix: Approve it like the other known install scripts (it never ships in the app), then rerun the dependency check

entries.symptom: npm install prints "N moderate severity vulnerabilities" and suggests npm audit fix
entries.cause: The advisories are usually in build tooling (config plugins, test tools) that never ships in the app
entries.fix: Never run npm audit fix (with --force it moves expo off the SDK); review each advisory and upgrade the owning package deliberately

entries.symptom: A just-published package (hours or days old) breaks after install
entries.cause: Brand-new releases of fast-moving packages (ads, IAP, audio) regularly ship regressions
entries.fix: Respect the 7-day release age, pin exactly, test risky ones on their test tiers, and note the rollback version

entries.symptom: A 0.x native package behaves differently after a minor bump, or npx expo install picks no version for it
entries.cause: It is pre-1.0 (0.x minors break) and outside Expo's module map
entries.fix: Pin the exact version, read the release notes on every bump, override its plugin defaults deliberately, and rerun the device smoke test

entries.symptom: error TS7016: Could not find a declaration file for module '<package>'
entries.cause: The package was installed without its companion @types package
entries.fix: Install both in one command (npm install -D -E <package>@<v> @types/<package>@<v>)
match: TS7016: Could not find a declaration file for module

entries.symptom: TS2307: Cannot find module 'fast-check' right after copying property tests
entries.cause: The property tests import fast-check, which a fresh app does not have
entries.fix: npm install -D -E fast-check@4.10.2 at the repo root, then review pending install scripts

entries.symptom: knip reports hundreds of unlisted dependencies or unused files in a repo that holds installed skills
entries.cause: knip's Jest plugin falls back to test patterns anywhere in the repo, so it reads the skills' templates and fixtures
entries.fix: Ignore the agent skill folders (skills/**, .agents/**, .claude/** ...) in knip.json, as the canonical knip.json does; never a wider ignore

entries.symptom: knip reports expo-updates as unlisted or unused
entries.cause: knip's Expo plugin assumes an app ships expo-updates unless the config says otherwise
entries.fix: Wire OTA with ota-updates (updatesConfig()), or list expo-updates in ignoreDependencies with its reason until then

entries.symptom: knip reports a package as unused although the app needs it
entries.cause: The package is used only through an app.config.ts plugin entry or native code
entries.fix: Check that it is really used; then list it in ignoreDependencies with its reason (contracts/knip-ignores.json) and a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: knip reports "Unlisted binaries" (plutil, pgrep, sqlite3, footprint) in scripts/
entries.cause: The tooling starts macOS system tools by name; they are not npm packages
entries.fix: List them in ignoreBinaries with their reason; any other unlisted binary is a real finding (install it or stop calling it)

entries.symptom: knip reports unlisted dependencies inside __mocks__/
entries.cause: Root mocks import the real libraries' types and helpers
entries.fix: Make sure the library is a dependency of the app; a mock for a package the app does not use is deleted

entries.symptom: knip reports unused exports in src/test-only-entry.ts
entries.cause: Those exports are reached only through the gated require() in src/test-only.ts, which knip does not follow
entries.fix: Type the gate from the entry (typeof import of the entry, as the debug-menu template does) so knip sees every export as used; never ignore the file

entries.symptom: knip reports unused exports of an adopted template's API that the app never calls
entries.cause: knip counts only imports; the app adopted a module but uses part of it
entries.fix: Delete what the app does not use, or use it; never add a knip ignore for app code
